description: ipld/header_map.rs is_valid_header_name() only allows [A-Za-z0-9-]. RFC 7230 §3.2 defines header field names as token characters, which include underscore ('_'). Usenet article headers like X-Original_To or X_Spam_Status (produced by SpamAssassin and Mailman) will be rejected and dropped by build_header_map, silently losing information. The character class should be expanded to include at least underscore, or the code should use the RFC 7230 token definition.
title: core: header_map is_valid_header_name rejects valid header names containing underscore
